title: Problems at Work

expressions.example: That email must have slipped through the cracks.
After the error, we were back to square one.

expressions.expr: Get to the bottom of something
expressions.example: We need to get to the bottom of this issue.

sentences: I was working when the power went out.
She was presenting when her laptop crashed.
While we were discussing the plan, the client called.
He was writing the report when he made a mistake.
They were finishing the project when the deadline changed.
I was checking my email when I noticed the error.
We were having a meeting when the fire alarm rang.
She was explaining the issue when I interrupted her.

grammar.title: Past Continuous + Past Simple — Ações Interrompidas
rules: Past continuous (was/were + -ing) descreve uma ação em andamento no passado: I was working...
Past simple descreve a ação que interrompe: ...when the power went out.
"While" + past continuous também introduz a ação de fundo: While we were discussing the plan, the client called.
